text:
kevin: heads up — saw console list rows from org B after I did a fast org switch from A -> B. looked like a brief fanout where prefetch returned stale org-scoped results.
anna: ugh. can you repro? steps?
kevin: yeah: quick switch, open sidebar, click saved-search, sometimes results show org-A rows for ~1s then refresh. happened 3x in 10 mins.
sam: possible cache key bug in the prefetch layer. maybe affinity header not applied to the redis key.
maria: could also be the routing policy: we add x-org-affinity to request but the background prefetch uses internal API without that header.
kevin: exact header I saw in the network panel: `x-org-affinity: org-A;route=fast` — but the prefetch call in console code is `fetch('/api/internal/search/prefetch')` no headers.
anna: can you paste a minimal repro? a small HAR or curl would help.
kevin: quick curl I used: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-org-affinity: org-A;route=fast" "https://console.redwood/api/search?q=recent"` prefetch call missing header in js stacktrace attached (stack lines).
sam: thinking out loud — two fixes: 1) make prefetch attach runtime org header, 2) change internal API to require explicit org param and assert route affinity before returning cached results.
maria: +1 on require param. safer to fail than leak. also add a telemetry counter when request and cache org mismatch.
anna: does rollout UX need to change? this would be bad if canary users see cross-org rows during rollout.
kevin: we saw it on a dev canary group earlier today. not great.
maria: created issue: https://tracker/redwood/ENG-PLAT-1187 — adding telemetry proposal and API guard.
sam: quick patch idea: in internal handler add `if (!req.headers['x-org-affinity'] || cache.org != req.headers['x-org-affinity']) { emitMetric('org_mismatch'); return 412; }`
kevin: 412 is fine — better than silent leakage. add clear log so SRE can search.
anna: can we also add a console-level optimistic UI fallback: show skeleton then confirm results once affinity-checked? reduces flash of wrong rows.
maria: agree. I'll add to the PR.
Deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary/infra at 2027-05-10T14:40Z (PR #4128) :rocket:
kevin: thanks. assigning sam to the API guard, maria to telemetry, anna to console UX fallback. I'll circle back after canary run. :thumbsup:
anna: thanks all — priority P1 for rollback risk.
kevin: logging note — include `prefetch_key` and `affinity` when emitting metric, helps trace.
maria: noted. I'll instrument and put alert threshold at >1/min.
sam: patch up in next hour, will post PR link.
kevin: awesome. saved a customer-visible leak.
